name: gptme
description: Terminal chat-CLI that empowers LLMs with shell, Python, file-editing, and browser tools to complete tasks in a working directory.
command: export HOME=/tmp && cd /work && exec gptme -n -y -m openai/gpt-4o-mini -w /work "$SMADP_AGENT_TASK"
notes: Real upstream image (ghcr.io/gptme/gptme, linux/amd64 — runs under emulation on arm64). Runs headless via `gptme -n -y` (non-interactive, auto-confirm); the task is delivered through SMADP_AGENT_TASK and gptme acts on the mounted /work directory.
